purpose: Explicit list of biological elements/events that must NOT be animated for each preset, with the reason. Enforces the scientific-integrity rules.
global_prohibitions: oral administration / swallowing / GI transit for B1
intact nanoparticles reaching deep tissue (subcutis) without evidence
confusing nanoparticle penetration with released-API penetration (label which is shown)
human skin depicted for rat-skin data without a transfer label
human melanoma depicted for B16BL6 murine data without a label
merging HaCaT + rat skin + B16BL6 culture + mouse tumour into one unlabelled scene
aggregation shown as inevitable when only a risk is known
exact concentration fields without quantitative evidence
microscopy stain colors used as natural colors without explanation
decorative cells added only for visual complexity

prohibited: ECM traversal as a quantified process
human invasive-melanoma histology as the model
B1.reason: topical single-study rat/mouse evidence; systemic/organelle/immune/quantitative-precipitation data NOT REPORTED

B2.reason: abstract/preview level; only the ER->ICD mechanism chain is supported (qualitatively)

B3.reason: molecular inclusion complex (NOT a nanoparticle); comparator info panel only
